priority: an explicit single-purpose request selects its atomic skill; otherwise route output-oriented DesignCraft work to the default skill

routes.intent: Create or coordinate a complete multi-page layout deliverable
examples: Create a six-page product handout and save an editable project
Revise this publication and prepare a reviewable PDF
routes.sideEffects: May install the pinned runtime and write only within the user-authorized work and output paths

routes.intent: Explicitly inspect or execute the native command interface
examples: Describe the parameters of command file.new
routes.sideEffects: list, describe, and check are queries; run may install the runtime and edit files

routes.intent: Install or diagnose the pinned native runtime
examples: Check why the DesignCraft runtime failed to install
routes.sideEffects: Installation writes to the selected user runtime directory and requires authorization

routes.intent: Perform an explicit native project lifecycle operation
examples: Open this DesignCraft project and save a copy
Reopen the saved project and verify its page count
routes.sideEffects: Opening is read-oriented; saving or creating a project writes to the authorized destination

routes.intent: Inspect or modify frames, text flow, or image placement
examples: Adjust the text frame and link it to the next page
Place this image into the selected frame
routes.sideEffects: Native layout commands may modify the project; preserve an authorized working copy

routes.intent: Export an existing project to a requested publication format
examples: Export the saved project as a PDF
Create PNG previews from this existing project
routes.sideEffects: Writes export files to the authorized destination; format fidelity needs separate inspection

unrelatedExamples: Explain the history of Swiss typography
Build a web dashboard unrelated to DesignCraft
